node: Sender node driven by the factory gauge (Q-301)
front_end: High-Z observer: 1 MΩ series → 330 kΩ to ground (×0.248: 12 V → 2.98 V; 20 V → 4.96 V, clamped), 100 nF at the ADC pin, BAT54S to 3V3 / GND. DNP: 100 Ω 1 W pull-up to +5 V behind a jumper — the local excitation for the day the factory cluster leaves (Q-301b), never fitted while the gauge still drives the node
calibration: Three-point lookup read in the car against the gauge (the D-142 method); averaged in firmware if M-6 shows a pulsing gauge regulator (Q-301a)
note: New factory-spec sender fitted before the read (electrical D-250)

node: Sender node driven by the factory gauge; the PMU's A7 watches it too (electrical D-249)
front_end: High-Z observer: 1 MΩ series → 330 kΩ to ground (×0.248: 12 V → 2.98 V; 20 V → 4.96 V, clamped), 100 nF at the ADC pin, BAT54S to 3V3 / GND. DNP: 100 Ω 1 W pull-up to +5 V behind a jumper — the local excitation for the day the factory cluster leaves (Q-301b), never fitted while the gauge still drives the node
calibration: Same in-car lookup; compare against the PMU's A7 reading — a disagreement is a sender or wiring fault
note: The fuel-pump gate is the PMU's, on A7 — never this input (electrical D-251)

node: Sender node driven by the factory gauge
front_end: High-Z observer: 1 MΩ series → 330 kΩ to ground (×0.248: 12 V → 2.98 V; 20 V → 4.96 V, clamped), 100 nF at the ADC pin, BAT54S to 3V3 / GND. DNP: 100 Ω 1 W pull-up to +5 V behind a jumper — the local excitation for the day the factory cluster leaves (Q-301b), never fitted while the gauge still drives the node
calibration: Three-point lookup 6 Ω full · 31.5 Ω mid · 80 Ω empty (electrical D-249 carries the curve), re-measured after the new tank sender
note: Was the PMU's A7 until D-249; the ICU is the only source now

source: DP-ICU-B 4 — tap on L1-S1 6, shielded, trailing coil negative (D-304)
node: Ignition primary — inductive kick, hundreds of volts
front_end: 2 × 100 kΩ ½ W in series → 5.1 V zener to ground + BAT54S to 3V3 → LM393 comparator with ~0.5 V hysteresis (or 74HC14 Schmitt) → digital input-capture pin. Shield grounded at the dash node end only
calibration: 2 pulses per revolution (D-304 / D-300); check against tach_simulator, then the car
note: V-082 confirms the parts; the H11L1 opto is the alternative if the comparator picks up noise

source: DP-ICU-B 5 — tap on L1-S2 8, alternator L (WB)
node: Lamp-drive line, 0 V charging fault / ~system volts charging
front_end: 47 kΩ / 10 kΩ divider (20 V → 3.5 V), RC 10 kΩ / 100 nF, BAT54S
calibration: Threshold from the in-car reading, engine off vs running

source: DP-ICU-B 6 — tap on DP-CLU 9 (fluid-level switch + parking-brake switch, one node)
node: Lamp node pulled low by either switch
note: One tell-tale for both, as the factory lamp was (D-310)

source: DP-ICU-B 7 — L1-S2 10, capped past the grommet; no sender exists
node: New 2-wire NTC sender to engine ground (Q-308)
front_end: Pull-up from 3V3 sized to the sender's curve (1 kΩ – 2.2 kΩ 1 % typical), RC 1 kΩ / 100 nF, BAT54S; a 3-wire transducer would use the L1-S2 9 supply instead
calibration: Sender datasheet curve, one-point check in hot oil
note: Sender, thread and range are Q-308

source: DP-ICU-B 8 — L4-S 3, capped in the tunnel; supply on L4-S 4
node: Hall / open-collector sensor, 12 V square wave (electrical D-252)
front_end: Jumper-selected: 4.7 kΩ pull-up to 3V3 for open-collector, or 10 kΩ / 4.7 kΩ divider for a push-pull 12 V output; BAT54S; Schmitt → input-capture pin
calibration: Pulses per kilometre over a measured mile or against GPS
note: Head-end inline sensor vs transmission is Q-309 / M-2; a VR sensor is not supported on these conductors

front_end: I²C + INT; mounting per the D-161 axes
calibration: Zero at rest on level ground; V-073 orientation before layout
